lead: Shooting stars are tiny bits of comet dust burning up in the air. On the same nights every year, Earth passes through the same dust.
try: Choose your City and how dark Your sky is. The page shows the best hour to watch.
points: The best showers give up to about 100 shooting stars an hour from a really dark place, far fewer in a city.
Watch after midnight, lie back and look at the whole sky. A bright Moon hides the faint ones.
Each shower comes from one comet, which left its dust along its path.
